description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): a new install target that stages the binary needs `clean` to also remove the staged copy
prompts: Add an `install` target that copies the built binary into a new `stage/` directory (`stage/app`) - it must depend on `all` (order-only is fine for the `stage` directory itself, but the binary must genuinely be built first) so `make install` alone still produces a working staged copy from a clean tree. This isn't self-contained: the existing `clean` target currently only removes `bin/` and the generated `.o`/`.d` files - update it to ALSO remove `stage/`, otherwise `make clean` leaves stale installed artifacts behind even though it's supposed to reset the tree to a pristine state.

test_setup_files.check_install_clean.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'install'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make install failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'
assert Path('stage/app').exists(), 'make install must produce stage/app'

r2 = subprocess.run(['make', 'clean'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r2.returncode == 0, f'make clean failed:\n{r2.stdout}\n{r2.stderr}'

assert not Path('stage').exists(), (
    "stage/ still exists after 'make clean' - clean must remove the staged install "
    "artifacts too, not just the original bin/ build output")
assert not Path('bin').exists(), 'bin/ should also be removed by clean'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

STAGEDIR := stage
STAGED_TARGET := $(STAGEDIR)/app

TEST_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

.PHONY: all clean test install

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

$(STAGEDIR):
	mkdir -p $(STAGEDIR)

install: $(TARGET) | $(STAGEDIR)
	cp $(TARGET) $(STAGED_TARGET)

test: $(TEST_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_TARGET)

$(TEST_TARGET): $(TEST_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_SRCS) -o $(TEST_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(STAGEDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
